WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) as avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT 
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  avg_per_day_price,
  avg_per_day_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_price) FROM rating_stats) as per_day_ratio
FROM rating_stats
ORDER BY rating
